name: net.yozolab.xestrel
description: Per-avatar Material isolation for VRChat with on-demand Texture isolation. Bulk-copies referenced Materials into Assets/Xestrel/<AvatarName>/Materials/ and rewires Renderers; individual Textures are copied on demand from the editor window into Assets/Xestrel/<AvatarName>/Textures/. The state is tracked on a VRC IEditorOnly component so it is stripped on upload.
